findings: Prop. 10 (l.1122–1125): the hypothesis supportK F ≠ S(n) added by prop10_contingent_conique excludes exactly one facette, the interior one. For a convex body W of S(n), F is a facette of W with support S(n) iff F = int W (isFacetteK_supportK_eq_univ_iff), and int W is then conical (interior_isFacetteConique). So the printed statement fails at exactly one conical facette, F = int W, where S(n)/L is empty (interior_facette_conique). It holds at every other conical facette (prop10_contingent_conique_of_ne_interior). This closes the gap AUDIT-1 finding 2 of T-bz-c3-facette-conique flagged.

General fact, beyond what the paper needs: for any convex part W of S(n) (not only a convex body), the facette of a point of int W is int W (facetteK_eq_interior), and a facette with support S(n) is int W, so int W ≠ ∅ (eq_interior_of_supportK_eq_univ).
questions: OQ-169 (a), unchanged and OPEN: read « F une facette conique » as every conical facette (then the statement is false at F = int W) or as every conical facette but the interior one (proved)? With this file the two readings differ by exactly the facette int W. The reading I took is the second one, stated as an explicit hypothesis, so I did not mark the label.

If affineSpan K′ = ⊤, preimage_coe_mem_nhds_subtype with nhdsWithin_univ turns intrinsic interior into interior. The facette order by supports (facetteLE_iff_support_le, FacetteLE.antisymm) identifies the facettes.
